title.narrative: The 2021-2024 UNICEF Seal edition has certified 933 municipalities out of 2,023 enrolled in the initiative that have improved social indicators, strengthened public policies, and guaranteed the rights of children and adolescents. For instance, 209,244 boy and girls were reenrolled at school, 130.211 opportunities of decent jobs were created for youth, and 54.457 adolescents were mobilized, with 24,684 adolescents trained on girls&39; empowerment and gender equality that impacted 217,000 people through 1,712 gender-responsive activities. In addition, a strategic moment of reflection was held in August with 57 national and subnational leaderships from indigenous and quilombolas communities to address a more gender, ethnical, and racial sensitive approach for UNICEF Seal’s next edition.
